# Mahi TechnoCrafts — company and service reference

## Company profile
Mahi TechnoCrafts is a web design, software development, and digital marketing business based in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India. It works with businesses in Bhopal and clients across India. The company is led by founder Vikash Maheshwari.

- Website: https://mahitechnocrafts.in
- Address: Hamidia Road, Badabagh, Shahjahanabad, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh 462001, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 6267144122
- Email: support@mahitechnocrafts.in
- About: https://mahitechnocrafts.in/about
- Contact: https://mahitechnocrafts.in/contact
- Portfolio: https://mahitechnocrafts.in/portfolio
- Services: https://mahitechnocrafts.in/services

## Services and scope

### Website design
Responsive website design, page structure, typography, accessible content presentation, and clear calls to action. The exact pages and design deliverables depend on the project.
Service page: https://mahitechnocrafts.in/website-design-company-bhopal

### Web development
Business websites, landing pages, web portals, and custom application workflows. Content management, third-party integrations, and ongoing support can be scoped where appropriate.
Service page: https://mahitechnocrafts.in/web-development-company-bhopal

### Ecommerce development
Product catalogues, categories, checkout, payment-provider integrations, and order-management workflows. Provider availability, account approval, fees, and third-party terms are outside the company's control.
Service page: https://mahitechnocrafts.in/ecommerce-development-company-bhopal

### Mobile app development
Android and iOS app planning and development, integrations, testing, release preparation, and handover. Platform account requirements and store approval decisions are controlled by Google and Apple.
Service page: https://mahitechnocrafts.in/mobile-app-development-company-bhopal

### Business software
Custom dashboards, CRM, inventory, billing, and team workflows can be planned around the client's operational requirements. Features and integrations are confirmed during project scoping.
Services overview: https://mahitechnocrafts.in/services

### AI and workflow automation
AI-assisted chat and workflow automation can be scoped for common questions, enquiry routing, and team processes. Integrations depend on the client's tools, data access, and provider requirements; no particular model or integration should be assumed without confirmation.
Service page: https://mahitechnocrafts.in/services/ai-solutions

### Search engine optimization
Technical SEO reviews, local search guidance, page structure, internal links, useful content, structured data, and performance measurement. No provider can guarantee a specific position or date for ranking changes.
Service page: https://mahitechnocrafts.in/seo-company-bhopal

### Digital marketing
Campaign planning, content and social direction, landing pages, paid search, and measurement may be included according to goals and budget. Advertising spend is separate from service fees unless explicitly agreed otherwise.
Service page: https://mahitechnocrafts.in/digital-marketing-company-bhopal

### Google Ads
Campaign and keyword planning, location targeting, landing-page alignment, conversion tracking, and performance reviews. Results depend on demand, competition, budget, offer, and landing-page experience.
Service page: https://mahitechnocrafts.in/google-ads-agency-bhopal

## How projects are handled
Projects begin by discussing goals, intended users, requirements, existing tools, integrations, budget, and timeline. The parties agree on scope and deliverables before work begins. Progress can be reviewed in stages. Hosting, maintenance, support, advertising spend, and third-party charges are agreed separately where applicable.

## Enquiries
For a project-specific discussion, use https://mahitechnocrafts.in/contact or call/WhatsApp +91 6267144122. Current availability, pricing, timelines, and deliverables should be confirmed directly with Mahi TechnoCrafts.
